name: Aberdeen City
title: Aberdeen —
tagline: A silver-grey city by the North Sea, energy capital and home of the Dons.
summary: Aberdeen is built of local granite that glitters in the sun, and for fifty years has been the centre of Europe's North Sea oil and gas industry. It also has two universities and a long fishing and shipping history.
The city has a notable library, art gallery and the Marischal College, one of the largest granite buildings in the world.

community.intro: Aberdonians left for Canada, North America and Australia, and many returned with the oil industry; the Doric dialect is proudly kept alive.
